question: Babur, the first Mughal emperor, succeeded to the throne of Ferghana in 1494 when he was only _______ years old.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Babur **was a descendant of Timur and Genghis Khan. His original name was **Zahiruddin Muhammad**. 
 
• In** 1494 at the age of 12**, **Babur** became the** ruler of Farghana (at present in Chinese Turkistan) succeeding Umar Shaikh Mirza, his father.**
 
• **Babur** succeeded in securing the **dynasty's position in Delhi **after a series of **sultanates failed to consolidate their seats and his empire went on to rule for over 300 years in India. **

**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kingdom of Ferghana **was ruled by the Ikhshids, who submitted as vassal to the Chinese Tang between 659 and 790.**
 
• It was attacked by the** Tibetan Empire in 715. **The **Umayyad Caliphate in 715 deposed the ruler, and installed a new king Alutar on the throne.**
 
• **The throne of Ferghana** represents **the royal crown of the place or region or kingdom or territory inherited**.
